home.aboutTitle: A Story of Passion and Sharing
home.aboutP1: Founded on August 16, 2025 by Oli Nganzi, an entrepreneur from the Central African diaspora, La Banguissoise was born from a strong ambition: to create a cultural and gastronomic bridge between Bangui and Kigali, one of the most dynamic cities in Africa.
home.aboutP2: Whether you are an expatriate, diplomat, business traveler or simply curious, our establishment welcomes you in a refined setting where the legendary hospitality of Central Africa meets Rwandan dynamism.
home.restaurantDesc: Central African specialties like the famous Maboké, and Rwandan delights.
home.hebergementDesc: Elegant rooms for a stay of gentleness and serenity.
home.platsDesc: A glimpse of our most appreciated culinary creations, blending Central African tradition with local influences.
home.chambresDesc: Spaces designed for your comfort, blending discreet elegance with modern amenities.
home.aProposKCC: A few steps from the Kigali Convention Center

menu.maboke.name: Le Maboké Traditionnel
menu.maboke.desc: Fresh fish steamed in banana leaves
menu.maboke.longDesc: Fresh fish steamed in banana leaves with local spices, served with cassava or plantains. A flavorful journey to the heart of Central Africa, prepared according to the traditional recipe passed down through generations.
menu.ngoundja.name: Ngoundja
menu.ngoundja.desc: Mashed cassava leaves with peanut paste
menu.ngoundja.longDesc: Mashed cassava leaves prepared with peanut paste and smoked beef. A dish rich in flavor and tradition, served with fragrant rice or chikwangue.
menu.capitaine.name: Grilled Capitaine
menu.capitaine.desc: Whole capitaine fish grilled with spices
menu.capitaine.longDesc: Whole capitaine fish grilled with Central African spices, served with chikwangue and fresh vegetables. A must-try specialty that delights grilled fish lovers.
menu.brochettes.name: Goat Brochettes
menu.brochettes.longDesc: The iconic Rwandan brochettes, grilled to perfection, served with plantain fries and homemade spicy sauce. A crowd-pleasing classic.
menu.isombe.name: Isombe
menu.isombe.longDesc: Cassava leaves in bone broth with spinach and eggplant, a comforting Rwandan classic. Served with ugali or rice.
menu.tilapia.name: Lake Kivu Tilapia
menu.tilapia.longDesc: Fresh tilapia fried or grilled with spicy tomato sauce, served with ugali and seasonal vegetables. A Great Lakes specialty evoking the authentic flavors of Rwanda.
rooms.standard.longDesc: A comfortable and functional room, ideal for travelers seeking quality at a budget-friendly price. Equipped with a double bed, air conditioning, and a private bathroom, it offers everything needed for a pleasant stay in the heart of Kigali.
rooms.deluxe.longDesc: Immerse yourself in absolute comfort with our Deluxe room. Its refined decor, Queen size bed, and stunning city view make it the perfect choice for discerning travelers seeking serenity.
rooms.executive.longDesc: Designed for business professionals on the go, the Executive Suite combines functionality and elegance. A dedicated work desk, King size bed, and high-speed Wi-Fi allow you to work and relax in complete serenity.
rooms.presidential.longDesc: The pinnacle of luxury and refinement. The Presidential Suite features a private lounge, jacuzzi, 24/7 room service, and King size bedding. An exceptional experience reserved for discerning clientele.
